docs(kickoff): unblock README install-claims verification (#2149)

## Summary

Remove two contradictions from the existing README update task in #1993.
Its focused verification command now follows the allocated principle
filename and rejects zero or multiple matches before calling Vitest. The
required negative example now uses an agent noun covered by arm E.

The RED-first instructions reuse the focused command. Keep that command
on one line because the host verifier runs every line in a separate
shell. This corrects D1993-S01 and D1993-D01 in the kickoff; the pending
README implementation remains with its existing owner.

## Validation

- Four kickoff principle suites (12, 40, 43, 44): 28 tests passed.
- The exact focused command accepted allocated prefixes 50 and 61, and
rejected zero or duplicate matches before invoking the test runner in
isolated fixtures.
- Host-verifier listing recognized all five declared commands;
markdownlint and diff whitespace checks passed.
- Independent read-only review found no issues.
- Normal pre-commit and pre-push passed; the latter ran all 57 principle
files (675 passed, 1 skipped) and the 224-test documentation audit
suite. The hook reported its existing optional offline-link-check skip
because lychee is absent. No skip flags or API push path were used.

## Fidelity verdict

FIDELITY: skipped — focused correction of an existing dispatch contract;
this PR does not implement or accept the README update task.

## Parked questions

None for this correction. Owner acknowledgment, the runtime collision
check and the README implementation delivery estimate remain pending in
the [owner
follow-up](https://github.com/artyhoo/getff/pull/1993#issuecomment-6722228729).

### §1.7 Skipped: mechanical correction of an existing kickoff command
and a contradictory example; no discipline rule or product capability is
introduced.

Prior-art: skipped — focused correction of an existing dispatch
contract, no new capability

---------

Co-authored-by: t <t@t>
